v1.source: coach_answers_full.md (138 of 140 questions answered) + coach_answers.md; the coach answers are AUTHORITATIVE and override every sheet inference and every v0 decision

applied.change: Bands removed everywhere: no 'band' / 'band_anchor' kit tokens, BANDS_ONLY profile deleted, HOME_DB_BENCH_BANDS -> HOME_DB_BENCH, bands dropped from every add-on and buy list. Ideal home kit = adjustable DBs + bench + pull-up bar + 8-10 lb medball.

Variable resistance out of scope: 'chains' token and weight releasers gone; banded / reverse-banded box squats AI92, AI93, AI95, AI96 removed; 'FAST BANDED' / 'CHAINED' lifts run with straight weight at 'FAST RPE6 or about 60-70%'; the v0 accommodating-resistance block is replaced by load_velocity.variable_resistance (out of scope) and out_of_scope_implements (history).

14 library cells leave every list and count (exercise_index keeps them with the reason): U15 band-assisted pull-up; AI92/AI93/AI95/AI96; the 8 'Knee banded for adduction' FBS items (replaced by their 'Hold object Adducted between knees' twins); AQ16 Camporini (LIB-09 'ignore'). 6 'cable or band' names are shown with the cable route only.

30 v0 band / reverse-band substitutes removed and replaced with a non-band option or dropped (_meta.v1.removed_v0_subs): band pulldowns -> foot-assisted pull-up, cable lat pull-over, DB pullover; band chops -> fast cable rotations; band leg extension / Spanish squat -> DB leg extension on a box, reverse Nordic, heels-elevated goblet; band Nordic -> eccentric-only Nordic; band calf raise -> seated DB calf raise; band rows/raises/curls/pushdowns -> cable or DB/KB versions.

Access profiles = the coach's 8 intake options (full gym, basic gym, home gym, home DB + bench, KB only, bodyweight only, hotel gym, field/track/outdoor kit). FULL_FACILITY and FIELD_TRACK_NO_KIT stay as derived (add-on) profiles; BOOTCAMP_OUTDOOR -> FIELD_TRACK_KIT; TRACK_FIELD -> FIELD_TRACK_NO_KIT (ids in _meta.v1.profile_id_changes).

Machine ranking retired: the Pendulum > Leg press > Hack order and the hack-squat demotion are gone from lists, picks and rules. Constraint differences instead: leg press 5; hack squat and pendulum back-supported 4; Smith 4 and least constrained. Belt squat added as a coach-named option (ADD-EQ11) for axial sparing. GHD / reverse hyper only if available and the client feels the target muscles.
The client may choose between alternatives (preference); each slot keeps a default plus a dropdown of its category (CR-31).
The 1-5 constraint scale is coach-approved; EQ-11 adds the order inside level 4 (GRD-4).

Older / injured / high-volume clients: compounds and isolation lean machine/cable; never overhead squat, snatch, low-bar squat or depth jumps (CR-33; enforced in the older_or_pain picks). FOUNDATIONAL clients may use machines filed MODERATE/ADVANCED (confirmed).
'Seated Machine Shoulder Press' added to VERTICAL PUSH (ADD-EQ05, constraint 5); a seated Smith press is its substitute.

Medball weights: passes/rotations 8-10 lb, overhead 6-10, sit-up 6-8, slams 10-20; heavier only for medball cleans / wall balls; never over 20 lb; lighter for youth and older clients; no throwing in the main workout for aesthetics (warm-up only) - the hypertrophy picks for the Throwing slot now say "not used".
No medball -> plyo push-ups, fast cable rotations, the no-ball 'fake medball slam'; band chops removed ('worthless').

No leg extension / leg curl machine -> swap: DB leg extension on a box, sissy squat (reverse Nordic PROPOSED); nordics, slider or swiss-ball curls. The 'add 2 rounds to front squats' rule is now the fallback.
Default implement when a name has none: bodyweight -> DB -> barbell as the level rises, within the kit (CR-30).
Aerobic work on any erg or running; tracked by distance, calories or time with one unit per block (CR-35); DISTANCE and CALORIES blocks open to every template.
Loaded jumps 10-20% of body weight, too heavy when jump height or speed drops; body weight is now an intake field.
Depth drops low 6-12 in / medium 12-18 in / high above hip; hurdles 6 in moderate, 12 in+ advanced (load_velocity.plyo_heights).

Everyone in athletic training gets Olympic-lift work. Four options from his programs are added as FOUNDATIONAL triple-extension options (ADD-ATH10-1..4: hang cleans without bumpers, single-arm DB snatch, KB squat cleans, hex-bar squat jumps).
No sex-based rules (CR-19 female medball modifier retired); youth may do some Olympic lifts from the floor (CR-18); older clients get few plyos unless they ask (CR-10).

Zones are Davidson rotation biases (rotation_bias tag added); zones do not apply to plyos (plyo zone tags removed); the Sheet23 plyo 'ZONE 1/2/3' key is an unnamed method progression; levels stay soft (LV-7, LV-8).
Push press back to FOUNDATIONAL ("easier"); push jerk INTERMEDIATE ("intermediate/advance"). v0 had both at ADVANCED.

applied.change: Session order: warm-up always; core FIRST by default (movable); power before strength; row before pulldown always but the main lift first whatever its direction; hip-dominant + push and knee-dominant + pull on every day type incl. bootcamps; supersets as a fatigue tool; MYO last on machines/isolation; calves 3 sets each leg day and rear delts their own sets. Retired exceptions: pulldown before row, strength above Olympic work, core placement by family.
Pain rule: machines or split grips plus a 30-50% cut, drop the exercise if still too much; keep the sets when a bilateral lift turns unilateral if possible (CR-12).
High-volume rule: added sets go to the exercises already in the session, first exercise first (CR-14).
Contralateral (into the hip, COD athletes) vs ipsilateral (out of the hip, sprint acceleration) loading rule; health accessory for bodybuilders/powerlifters in the first 2-4 weeks (CR-32).
Laterality-shift rule now defers to the adjustable bilateral:unilateral ratio (90/10 to 10/90, moved by pain) in 03_volume_dosing (CR-25).
Intake: sex removed; training experience in years with the coach's novice / intermediate definitions; body weight added; optional equipment preference.

how_to_use: 1. Intake -> pick one of the 8 intake options (intake.step_1_pick_base_profile) and add the add-on kit tokens; never offer bands, chains or weight releasers (CR-36).

2. For each template slot (bucket) take substitution_by_category[bucket][profile]; keep options with lvl <= client level (levels ADD options, CAT-05), then re-rank by client_rules (constraint band, preferences, pain). picks_by_client_family shows the result for 6 typical clients.

3. Library items carry src='library' (show display_name when present); coach-approved additions carry src='coach_addition'; substitutes carry substitute=true with flag same_pattern | partial | zone_shift | pattern_gap | rule. Prefer as-written, then same_pattern, then partial/zone_shift; report pattern_gap to the client with the buy list (the coach's ideal home kit, EQ-02). Respect 'laterality_shift' (CR-25) and 'axial_load' (CR-29). Let the client swap within the slot (dropdown, CR-31).
4. For a custom kit use exercise_index[cell].needs with the stated semantics.
5. Order the session with intent_sequence; dose with load_velocity.
_meta.ordering_of_lists: as-written options first (library items + coach-approved additions; excluded cells never appear): operative level (F < I/any < A), then demoted items last within a level (leg-extension copies in compound columns, misfiled items - v1: no machine is promoted or demoted for preference, EQ-11), then the coach-rule level (easiest first), then most constrained first, then coach usage, then library row; in athletic slots the additions follow the library items of their level; substitutes follow in curated preference order (a substitute that repeats a name already in the list is dropped); a misfiled library item that is not the slot pattern (misfiled_not_this_pattern: 'KB Face Pulls ' U20 in RP_VPULL) is listed last of all and never counts as as-written.

substitute_flag_definitions.same_pattern: the substitute is the same movement pattern with another implement
substitute_flag_definitions.partial: the substitute covers part of the pattern
substitute_flag_definitions.zone_shift: the substitute trains a different VELOCITY (force-velocity) zone than the slot, e.g. strength-speed -> reactive (broad jumps for a loaded clean); it is NOT a Davidson position zone (level_model) and NOT a plyo method stage (CAT-10/CAT-11)
substitute_flag_definitions.pattern_gap: no real option with this kit: show the substitute and the buy list (the coach's ideal home kit, EQ-02)
substitute_flag_definitions.rule: a coach rule replaces the slot (e.g. 'leg press or just add 2 more rounds to front squats')

_meta.tab_names_note: Sheet tab names are cited only to locate cells. 'JUSTICE LEAGUE' was a marketing name (COACH-ANSWER ATH-13) and is never shown as a program name (FIX-03: names must be general and understandable): the generator calls that program 'All-around athletic / weekend warrior (non-competitive adults and youth)' (profile weekend_warrior, as in 01_taxonomy and 04_athlete_profiles).

implement_groups.MACHINE_GUIDED: Fixed path plus seat/pads: the most reference points ("you sit down, feet on the ground, move your hands or feet", COACH-CHAT). The machine does the stabilising work (COACH-ANSWER CAT-04). Constraint 4-5.
implement_groups.CABLE: Free line of pull, constant tension; the cable takes part of the stabilising work (COACH-ANSWER CAT-04). Constraint 3 (standing) to 4 (seated/supported).
implement_groups.FREE_BAR: Barbell family: one rigid bar, fixed grip, highest load ceiling, most skill ("Barbells are more skilled", COACH-CHAT). The only implement that loads zone 3 BEHIND the body (back squat, good morning). Constraint 2.
implement_groups.FREE_HANDHELD: Dumbbells, kettlebells, plates, sandbag: split grip, unilateral/offset loading; one implement is enough for contra/ipsilateral work. Reach zones 1-3 but not behind the body. Constraint 2-3.
implement_groups.BALLISTIC_IMPLEMENT: Medicine ball, slam ball: released at speed. Constraint 1 (standing) to 3 (sit-up throws).
implement_groups.BODYWEIGHT_APPARATUS: Pull-up/dip bars, TRX/rings, stability ball, sliders: let bodyweight carry a pattern.
implement_groups.REFERENCE_PROPS: Boxes, benches, steps, walls, and plates/hurdles/cones used as targets: they set depth, ROM, height or a target, not load.
implement_groups.FIELD_SPACE: Open space (10-20 m, 40-60 m+), track, turf.

coach_answer.CAT_04: Mostly skill and stability demand, AND load POSITIONING. Load in front of you / front-loaded = foundational (goblet squat, front-loaded zercher) - people need to learn to be upright. Load closer to and on your body = intermediate (barbell front squat). Load behind your body = advanced (barbell back squat). Based on Dr. Pat Davidson's 'A Coach's Guide to Optimizing Movement' ZONES: Zone 1 = closer to the body at the bottom (arms low) - easiest; Zone 2 = horizontal (high-pressure, but safer to push and pull) - intermediate; Zone 3 = overhead/vertical - most advanced (more positioning, stability and skill needed). Machines or cables change this: easier, because the machine/cable does the stabilizing work.
coach_answer.CAT_05: Levels add options, they don't remove them. 'The levels are still very theoretical, so we don't need to rely heavily on them.'
coach_answer.CAT_06: Client level and exercise level are separate axes.
coach_answer.CAT_10: Zones come from Dr. Pat Davidson's 'A Coach's Guide to Optimizing Movement' and are ROTATION BIASES: vertical positions (hands down / standing, hands overhead, deep squat) = external-rotation bias; horizontal positions (hands in front, knee at hip height / half squat) = zone 2 = internal-rotation bias, more compressive. 'It doesn't apply to the plyos. The plyos are different.'
coach_answer.CAT_11: The plyo progression (receive and pause -> receive then create -> repeatedly receive and create) is 'not necessarily a plyo zone ... I don't know what to call it yet'.

generator_policy: LV-1 (CAT-05) Levels ADD options: a client at level L may use every exercise whose operative level <= L. Never remove a foundational option from an advanced client.
LV-2 (CAT-05) Levels are soft: the operative level is a ranking input and an eligibility ceiling, not the main driver; constraint band, goal and pain rules decide among eligible options.
LV-3 (CAT-06) Client level (training age, skill) and exercise level are separate axes: an advanced athlete still gets foundational exercises when the slot purpose or a pain flag asks for them.

LV-4 (CAT-04, LIB-13, LIB-08, EQ-04) Operative level = library level, except the explicit overrides listed (back squats up to ADVANCED; push jerk up to INTERMEDIATE while push press keeps FOUNDATIONAL; front-loaded high zercher down to FOUNDATIONAL; low-skill guided machines down to FOUNDATIONAL so older/injured FOUNDATIONAL clients can use them - EQ-04 RIGHT; GHD no level).

LV-5 (CAT-04, PER-06, CAT-05) When a slot moves up (end of a block, the exercise felt '8 - That was perfect' or easier and no pain - PER-06), the next option may be one step along the zone ladder - zone 1 (goblet, zercher, hex, suitcase) -> zone 2 (front rack, horizontal) -> zone 3 (back-loaded, overhead) - or one guidance step less (machine -> cable -> free; GRD-2). Optional, never required: the levels are 'still very theoretical' (CAT-05, LV-8).
LV-6 (INFERRED from CAT-04) The zone also explains the session order the coach states: horizontal (zone 2, "safer to push and pull" heavy) before vertical (zone 3, more positioning and skill).

LV-7 (CAT-10) Zones do not apply to plyos; plyos progress by method (receive & pause -> receive then create -> repeated receive/create, CAT-10/11), bilateral -> unilateral (unilateral is harder) and height (EQ-16).
LV-8 (CAT-05/CAT-10) Levels are theoretical: never block a client from an exercise only because of its zone or level when constraint, goal, pain and preference rules say it fits.
level_model.rotation_bias_scope: rotation_bias is read from the arm / load position (hands down = zone 1 external, hands in front = zone 2 internal, overhead = zone 3 external). For the hips and knees the coach ties the bias to depth, not to where the load sits: standing and deep squat = external-rotation bias, knee at hip height / half squat = internal-rotation bias, compressive (COACH-ANSWER CAT-10). So a lower-body exercise has both readings; the load-position zone sets the level (CAT-04) and the depth sets the hip bias. Zones do not apply to plyos (CAT-10). The levels built on zones are 'still very theoretical' (CAT-05).

kit_tokens.open_space_long: 40-60 m+ runway, track, field or a safe road for running
kit_tokens.plate_low_target: weight plate laid flat or any low stable target
kit_tokens.plyo_box_high: plyo box at or above hip height
kit_tokens.seal_bench: seal row bench (or bench on boxes)
kit_tokens.barbell_bumpers_platform: bumper plates + a place where the bar may be dropped
kit_tokens.machine_selectorized: pin-loaded machines (leg ext/curl, pulldown, row, chest press, shoulder press, calf)
kit_tokens.machine_specialty: specialty machines (pendulum squat, hip-thrust machine, good-morning machine)
kit_tokens.belt_squat: belt squat machine (load hangs from a hip belt: no axial spinal load, COACH-ANSWER EQ-11)
kit_tokens.cardio_machine_cal: bike / rower / ski erg with calorie readout

BASIC_GYM.label: Basic commercial gym, no specialty machines/bars
BASIC_GYM.typical_client: most gym members; apartment/corporate gyms with a cable stack

HOME_BARBELL.label: Home/garage gym: barbell + rack + plates + bench + dumbbells (pull-up bar on the rack)

BODYWEIGHT.label: Bodyweight only / no access (floor, wall, stairs, chair, towel, outdoor space)

HOTEL_GYM.label: Hotel gym: light-moderate dumbbells, adjustable bench, stability ball, treadmill/bike

FIELD_TRACK_KIT.label: Field / track / outdoor kit: medballs, slam balls, cones, mini hurdles, boxes, field or track (EQ-01 wording)

FIELD_TRACK_NO_KIT.label: Field / track with nothing carried (runway, bleacher steps, turf)

intake.step_1_note: The coach's eight options (COACH-ANSWER EQ-01 RIGHT, minus bands): full commercial gym, basic gym, home gym (rack + barbell + DBs), home DBs + bench, kettlebells only, bodyweight only, hotel gym, field/track/outdoor kit. FULL_FACILITY and FIELD_TRACK_NO_KIT are reached through add-on answers.
step_3_space: open_space_long (40-60 m / track / safe road)? -> sprints, bounding, outdoor running
intake.step_4_why: constraint and spine loading differ by machine (EQ-11, PER-04) and the client may prefer one (EQ-10); machines are NOT ranked (EQ-11)
step_5_non_equipment_fields_that_change_: training experience in years (novice under ~6-12 months; intermediate over ~1 year consistent; more than 6-12 months off = beginner body, skills return fast; ex-pros at L1 only briefly - COACH-ANSWER GEN-02, PRG-05)
body weight (loaded jumps at 10-20% of body weight, EQ-15; GEN-02)
pain or injury areas (and which joints)
sport + position + season if competitive; general sport only if recreational (GEN-02)
goal (hypertrophy, strength, power/speed, athletic, fat loss, hybrid)
equipment preference: machines / free weights / dumbbells / no preference (EQ-10, INFERRED question)
max dumbbell pair weight (sets the ceiling for home loading)
intake.removed_fields: sex (COACH-ANSWER GEN-02: "I need you to take away just sex"; ATH-09: no sex-based rules); bands (EQ-01)
intake.rule: Never infer equipment from a template name (the NO ACCESS tabs are not equipment-filtered); filter options per slot from the intake answers only.

then.calves: 3 sets every leg day, single-leg on a ramp/plate/deficit or bilateral (COACH-ANSWER VOL-17)
then.rear_delts: their own sets, not only indirect pulling volume (VOL-17)

evidence: COACH-ANSWER CAT-02, VOL-11, VOL-17
COACH-CHAT volume statement (small muscles = more reps)
OBSERVED small-muscle library entries 55% DB/KB, 0% high skill

if.when: filling the knee- and hip-dominant main slots of a week

then.rule: one axially loaded squat day per week; the other knee-dominant day uses a leg press, belt squat or another non-axial option (COACH-ANSWER PER-04). Deadlifts load the spine too (PER-04), so the generator also keeps heavy barbell hinging to one day a week and fills a second hinge slot with hip thrust, back extension or reverse hyper - PROPOSED - PENDING COACH APPROVAL (open question)
then.tag: exercise_index[cell].axial_load = high | moderate | supported | none (INFERRED from the name; lower body only)
then.sore_or_already_loaded: swap the squat to the belt squat when the client was loaded on the back that week or is sore (COACH-ANSWER EQ-11)
then.no_machines: home clients: the second exposure uses a unilateral or front-loaded light option (split squat, goblet), PROPOSED - PENDING COACH APPROVAL

evidence: COACH-ANSWER PER-04: 'I can do one day of squatting and the other day of leg pressing. I don't want to always load the lower back and the spine twice per week ... I'm probably going to load it with the deadlifts as well'
COACH-ANSWER EQ-11 (belt squat)

if.when: the exercise name gives no implement (lunges, deadlifts, rows, calf raises, squats)

then.ladder: bodyweight -> DB -> barbell as the client level rises, limited by the kit (COACH-ANSWER EQ-09 - RIGHT)
then.override: client preference (CR-31) and the older/injured/high-volume rule (machines first, CR-33) win over the ladder

evidence: COACH-ANSWER EQ-09

if.when: a slot has alternatives ('Squats or Leg Press', 'DB or Barbell') or a dropdown

then.default: the generator picks a default by client rules (older/injured -> machine or DB; experienced -> barbell)
then.preference: the client may prefer one alternative and that can be completely up to them (COACH-ANSWER EQ-10 PARTLY)
then.dropdown: every slot keeps a dropdown of the other options of the same category (COACH-ANSWER GEN-04 - RIGHT)
then.intake: optional preference question: machines / free weights / dumbbells / no preference (INFERRED from EQ-10)

evidence: COACH-ANSWER EQ-10, GEN-04

if.when: a unilateral lift is loaded with one implement (contralateral / ipsilateral)

then.contralateral: load in the hand opposite the front leg: it pulls you INTO the hip - for change-of-direction athletes (football routes, soccer, basketball, tennis) (COACH-ANSWER CAT-13)
then.ipsilateral: load on the same side as the front leg: it helps you OUT of the hip - e.g. ipsilateral step-ups for the sprint acceleration phase (CAT-13)
then.bodybuilders_powerlifters: contra/ipsilateral work is a health accessory, mostly in the first 2-4 weeks, then bilateral symmetrical work dominates; kept later only if something bothers them (CAT-13)
then.equipment: one DB, KB or medball is enough (ALL ABOUT LUNGES!C22:C33 LOADING list)

evidence: COACH-ANSWER CAT-13
OBSERVED RP!C19:C26 'Contralateral loading' (GET INTO THE HIP) / 'Ipsilateral loading' (GET OUT OF THE HIP); 'Split stance ALWAYS contralateral' RP!G83

if.client: older OR injured OR in a high-volume block

then.equipment: compounds and isolation both lean machine/cable (constraint >=4): 'If they're old, they're injured, or they have a lot of high volume, I'd rather they collect that volume in a safe place with more constraints' (COACH-ANSWER EQ-03 - RIGHT)
then.eligible: FOUNDATIONAL clients may use machines the library files MODERATE/ADVANCED (EQ-04)

evidence: COACH-ANSWER EQ-03, EQ-04

then.no_medball: plyo push-ups (pressing), fast cable rotations, the no-ball 'fake medball slam'; never band chops (EQ-07)

evidence: COACH-ANSWER ATH-05, EQ-06, EQ-07

if.when: an aerobic (Blue / Green / Orange) block is scheduled

then.modality: any available erg or running: bike, rower, ski erg, treadmill or outdoors - non-runners are fine (COACH-ANSWER EQ-14)
then.tracking: distance, calories or time; keep one unit for the block so changes show week to week; do not throw away distance (EQ-14)
then.sessions_per_week: 3 general / fat loss, 2 athletes in season, 4 aesthetics / bodybuilders + long walks after workouts (COACH-ANSWER ATH-07; dose belongs to 03/06)

evidence: COACH-ANSWER EQ-14, ATH-07

aerobic_modality.rule: Blue / Green / Orange aerobic work runs on any erg or running (bike, rower, ski erg, treadmill, outdoors); non-runners are fine; track by distance, calories or time and keep one unit per block (COACH-ANSWER EQ-14 - RIGHT)
aerobic_modality.sessions_per_week: 3 general / fat loss, 2 athletes in season, 4 aesthetics / bodybuilders + long walks after workouts (COACH-ANSWER ATH-07; dose belongs to 03/06)
aerobic_modality.library_note: the DISTANCE (200-1000 m) and CALORIES blocks (B123:B141) are opened to every template (FIX-02 RIGHT: 'just make sure they're logical'); '21.6 mile run' B33 is flagged (coach: a marathon; a marathon is 26.2 mi)

load_velocity.older_adults: fast concentric at 40-60% 1RM on machines (30-60% frail) before jumps/throws (SCIENCE [S12][S41]); few plyos unless the client asks (ATH-09); never overhead squat, snatch, low-bar squat or depth jumps (EQ-03)
load_velocity.zones_note: load_velocity.zones are velocity (force-velocity) zones: reactive, speed-strength, strength-speed, accelerative/absolute strength, hypertrophy, local-fatigue. They are not the Davidson position zones of level_model.

coach_answer.EQ_11: NOT RIGHT (to 'hack squat ranked last'): 'my opinion on machines is that if the hack squat that you have in your gym works and you feel it is good, then that's great. If a Smith machine feels good, that's great. Some people have certain machines that are different, so they don't always feel the same. What I'm trying to do is I don't want to rank them because they have different brands, angles, and things like that ... Probably more constraint would be a hack squat and a leg press. Less constraint would be a Smith machine ... Belt squats are for people that you don't need to load them axially ... The GHD reverse hyper is also if they're available and if they feel good doing them ... I want them to feel the right muscles.'

machine_preferences.machine_first_vs_free_first: OBSERVED: gen-pop UL/PPL write the free weight first ('Sqats or Leg Press', 'Deadlifts (DB or Barbell)', 'DB Rows or Row machine'); the bodybuilding 12-week track writes the machine first ('Machine Dips or dips' x20, 'machine rows or db rows' x16, 'machine or db flies' x12, 'machine or db Reverse flies' x8). COACH-ANSWER EQ-10: the first-written option is not the default - pick by client, and the client's preference can decide.
machine_preferences.missing_machine_rule: COACH-ANSWER EQ-08: swap first (quads: DB leg extensions on a box, sissy squats, reverse Nordic; hamstrings: nordics, slider or swiss-ball curls) - no bands; fallback OBSERVED 'leg press or just add 2 more rounds to front squats' (MM 4 TRACKS!W42:Z42): a missing machine becomes +2 sets of the free-weight lift of the same pattern
generator_rules: Never V-squat (GEN-08).
No machine ranking (EQ-11); the sheet verdicts above are informational only.
Constraint differences decide when constraint matters: leg press 5 > hack / pendulum 4 (back-supported) > Smith 4 (trunk free) (EQ-11, EQ-13).
Belt squat or leg press for the second squat exposure of the week, or whenever the spine was already loaded or the client is sore (PER-04, EQ-11, CR-29).
GHD / reverse hyper / back extension only if available and the client feels the target muscles (EQ-11).
Machines carry near-failure work (MYO, RIR 0-1); never justify a machine to the client as "better for growth" (machines = free weights for hypertrophy [S1]).
Older / injured / high-volume clients: compounds and isolation lean machine/cable (EQ-03); FOUNDATIONAL clients may use the MODERATE/ADVANCED-filed machines (EQ-04).
Tag each machine ON_RAMP / VOLUME_TOOL / ISOLATION; ON_RAMP machines are swapped out as the client earns the free version (one reference per block).
Leg machines are eligible for FOUNDATIONAL clients (CAT-04 operative level), but the athlete constraint band keeps them out of athlete main slots.

answered_v0.q: Zones = where the load/hands sit, judged at the end position?
answered_v0.result: zones are positions with a rotation bias (vertical = external, horizontal = internal/compressive); level follows from them; zones do not apply to plyos. The end-position detail for chops is not confirmed but reproduces his FBS ladder 12/12 - kept, low priority

answered_v0.q: Push press and jerks AA11:AA14 FOUNDATIONAL vs CAT-04 overhead = advanced
answered_v0.result: push press stays FOUNDATIONAL (easier); push jerk INTERMEDIATE (intermediate/advanced)

answered_v0.q: High zercher AI47:AI48 MODERATE vs front-loaded zercher = foundational
answered_v0.result: FOUNDATIONAL

answered_v0.q: Low-skill leg/hip machines FOUNDATIONAL for older/injured/beginners?
answered_v0.result: kept

answered_v0.q: Medball weight per throw, lighter for women/youth/older?
answered_v0.result: 8-10 lb passes/rotations, overhead 6-10, sit-up 6-8, slams 10-20, heavier only for hang cleans / wall balls, never over 20 lb; lighter for youth/older; no sex-based rule

answered_v0.q: No medball: what goes in the Throwing slot? Meaning of FAKE MEDBALL SLAM
answered_v0.result: plyo push-ups, fast cable rotations, the no-ball fake slam; never band chops

answered_v0.q: Olympic lifts without bumpers?
answered_v0.result: everyone in athletic training gets Olympic work; beginners: DB/KB snatches and cleans, hex-bar jumps, hang pulls, hang cleans lowered under control

answered_v0.q: Seated machine shoulder press for VERTICAL PUSH?
answered_v0.result: added as 'Seated Machine Shoulder Press' ADD-EQ05

answered_v0.q: Leg Extensions slot with no machine?
answered_v0.result: swap (DB leg extension on a box, sissy squat; reverse Nordic proposed) - no bands

answered_v0.q: Whole leg-flexion segment for the Leg Curls slot?
answered_v0.result: yes: nordics, slider or swiss-ball curls when there is no machine

answered_v0.q: Minimum home kit with bands?
answered_v0.result: no bands; ideal home kit = adjustable DBs + bench + pull-up bar + 8-10 lb medball ('people have different things')

answered_v0.q: Rebalance the bilateral:unilateral ratio when a swap changes laterality?
answered_v0.result: keep the sets if possible but adjust; the ratio (90/10 to 10/90) is adjustable and pain moves it - handled by 03

answered_v0.q: Default implement when the name has none?
answered_v0.result: bodyweight -> DB -> barbell as level rises, limited by the kit (CR-30)

answered_v0.q: Chains 'slow you down' vs science; bands ~50% / chains ~70% of what?
answered_v0.result: no variable resistance at all for now

answered_v0.q: Horizontal before vertical for every client?
answered_v0.result: yes (BYOP order), except the main lift ('the work') always goes first

answered_v0.q: HYBRID/CrossFit 'STRENGTH' above 'OLY/POWER'?
answered_v0.result: power before strength

answered_v0.q: Which sports get more plyos?
answered_v0.result: ranking confirmed; plyo vs ballistic set by ground-contact time

answered_v0.q: Implement sizes as numbers (boxes, hurdles)?
answered_v0.result: drops low 6-12 in / medium 12-18 in / high above hip; hurdles 6 in moderate, 12 in+ advanced

answered_v0.q: Bike/rower/ski equal to running? Open DISTANCE/CALORIES?
answered_v0.result: any erg; track by distance, calories or time

answered_v0.q: Data: Camporini, Kong rows, strap rotating, AA50/AA51 twin
answered_v0.result: Camporini ignored (excluded); Kong row = double-KB row from the floor (pain option); strap rotating removed; AA51 = barbell press
